messages:
Carmen B: FYI PulseTech (pt-462) flagged low engagement after week 2. renewal in 21 days, CSM says execs uncertain about ROI.
Noah R: any usage drops? which signals?
Carmen B: active flows down 72%, key metric 'auto-tagged leads' zero last 3 days. they said data not matching expectations.
Vik S: could be mapping or downstream filter. can we pull a quick export of processed leads for last 14 days?
Elena T: propose a 3-part save: 1) create a 2-week ROI dashboard for the account (showing leads created, conversions, time saved), 2) 30-min exec review to walk ROI with their PM + our product lead, 3) offer a tailored 30% conversion bonus if they convert within 14 days.
Noah R: agree. engineering tasks: enable full-event export for pt-462 and add `debug_mode=true` for 72h so we can replay events.
Vik S: will enable per-account export and debug flag. command: `POST /internal/customers/pt-462/flags -d '{"debug_mode":true,"export_events":true}'`
CS Ops Bot: [action created] #ticket-7781 assigned to Elena T 
"PulseTech ROI reengage: dashboard + exec review + conversion incentive". Due: 2026-07-05
Carmen B: scheduled exec review Thu 9am PT. attendees: their Head of Ops, our product lead (Elena) and me. invite sent.
Elena T: I'll build a short ROI slide (3 slides): baseline, expected lift with features enabled, ask & commercial. adding a downloadable CSV of processed leads for their analysis.
Noah R: commercial note: if they still prefer to step down, prep downgrade bullets: prorated downgrade, preserve exports for 90 days, 30-day reactivation credit at 50%. add to ticket.
Elena T: added downgrade options and a neutral CS script in ticket-7781. script: "We can pause premium features and retain exports while you evaluate ROI; we'll keep a seat for reactivation and offer a rejoin credit."
Vik S: export enabled, audit_id=aud-9b2f. will monitor replays and post sample rows here in 10m.
Carmen B: during call we'll ask 3 quick questions for feedback: 1) what outcome were you expecting? 2) which step prevented value? 3) pricing sensitivity? please paste answers here after the meeting.
CS Ops Bot: [ticket-7781] status updated -> in-progress (Elena T).
Vik S: sample rows: `lead_id,created_at,source,score` 
Vik S: `l-1001,2026-06-01T14:12:00Z,webhook,0.12` `l-1002,2026-06-02T09:05:10Z,csv,0.09`
Elena T: post-call notes: Feedback: 1) they expected top-of-funnel lift within 7 days, 2) value blocked by tag-mapping mismatch to their CRM, 3) moderately price-sensitive but willing to pilot longer with clear ROI.
Carmen B: copied to ticket-7781 and bumped product eval. marking account "at-risk: ROI unclear" and setting renewal-check reminder day 14.
Noah R: follow-up ops: schedule a 2-hr mapping session with their CRM admin and our SRE to fix tag mapping. I'll book for Mon.
Elena T: customer accepted the conversion incentive if ROI dashboard shows >= 10% uplift in lead capture. leaving note in ticket.
CS Ops Bot: reminder -> mapping session Mon 10am PT; ticket-7781 due 2026-07-05."
